description: This file defines the SerializerSessionPool class, which manages a pool of SerializerSession objects for serialization purposes within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes methods for obtaining and returning sessions, as well as an internal policy class for session creation and reset.

classes.name: SerializerSessionPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of SerializerSession objects for efficient reuse during serialization operations.

classes.name: SerializerSessionPool.SerializerSessionPoolPolicy
classes.description: Defines the policy for creating and resetting SerializerSession instances within the pool.

methods.name: SerializerSessionPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session pool with provided codecs and type collections.

methods.name: GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves a SerializerSession from the pool.

methods.name: ReturnSession
methods.description: Returns a SerializerSession to the pool.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new SerializerSession with the specified configuration.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Resets and returns a SerializerSession to the pool.
